parts:
I made sure everything had the right boundary conditions
and was defined for all possible types (int arrays,
real arrays, vectors, row vectors, matrices), with the
right boundary conditions. I added tests, doc, and the
function signatures, and it looks like it's all good to go
for 1.0.2.

This all came up in the midst of size/shape tests for
matrices, which we needed for 1.0.2 to get rid of seg faults
that can crash R (and the command). Now back to matrices --
I'm almost done, then I don't have anything else for 1.0.2.

- Bob
